name: restricted-party-screen
title: US Restricted Party Screening (1260H, Section 889, FCC Covered, UFLPA, BIOSECURE)
description: Screen company, vendor or supplier names against five US restricted-party lists that the Consolidated Screening List does not carry: DoD 1260H (with named subsidiaries), Section 889, the FCC Covered List, the DHS UFLPA Entity List and the interim BIOSECURE list. Every match cites the government source.
